source_title: Wisconsin 2024 Post-Election Voting Equipment Audit Report
notes: Official report collected. WEC reported no evidence audited voting systems changed votes, incorrectly tabulated votes, altered outcomes, had programming errors, unauthorized alterations, hacking, or equipment malfunctions that changed contest outcomes.

source_title: Appendix B: Reporting Units Selected for Audit
notes: 373 selected reporting units normalized across 72 counties; 327230 audited ballots; 12 selected rows had zero ballots audited.
Published final report does not include a per-reporting-unit discrepancy outcome table; request local audit submission materials if this level is required.
